set.body: Independent sequence review exposed serialization before validation: forged Boolean numeric values become lawful-looking numbers. Sequence boundaries fixed at f38a97a91, but a targeted scout reproduced AlignmentPolicy.model_construct(max_candidates=True,...) -> validate_policy accepts integer1, while AlignmentPolicy.model_validate rejects. Audit and repair the existing public model-instance branches and receipt/recording consumers before JSON serialization; retain strict_json for raw strings/bytes and recursive revalidate_instances=always. Known public validators: model, alignment, source, rich_construction, rich_account, detail_admission, extraction, direct_mapping, study_workflow, intake_workflow, recall_intake, source_intake; corresponding recording/result verifiers also serialize inputs first. Preserve valid wire schemas, content IDs, canonical output, and frozen replay hashes. Add direct forged model_copy/model_construct Boolean numeric, extra-field, nested-instance and valid-object/raw parity regressions; raw JSON tests alone miss this defect. Use the current shared memory lesson9b2ceed7. Check actual current code before editing. Full affected/full Python checks, meaningful mutation, installed boundary probe and cold review required. Then continue rich relation/identity/structural consumers; this correctness repair does not replace P2-P6 scope.
